newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends narrowly mixed in consolidation.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends narrowly mixed in consolidation.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed narrowly mixed and the market appeared to be consolidating after the recent slide in prices, traders said.
"The week so far has been pretty much routine hedging or lifting of hedges which was giving the market some stability," a trader said.
The U.S. cash market action remains routine and Asian markets continue to trade at lower levels, they said.
Rice futures closed one cent per cwt higher to one lower, with November unchanged at $9.80 per cwt.
